data.rationale: The proposal follows the same five-stage procedure in the right order and uses the correct note template, but it drops the "4 or more stars" filter, the "don't click a time slot or Reserve" constraint, and the explicit search-box, Enter and "New note" interactions. It also lists the parameters as "cuisine and area" rather than separate cuisine, area and dish, and it names no sites or tabs, so an automation could not be built from it alone without guessing.
